app.title: CAR-T Oncology Trials Monitor
app.summary: A person opens the dashboard on registry trials fetched live (or pinned to a dated snapshot) and narrows them with cascading sidebar filters: disease branch, category and entity, then phase, target, status, product, modality, country, age group, sponsor type and classification confidence. Overview, map and deep-dive panels summarise the filtered set by category, target, phase, year, sponsor and geography. In the trial table they search, zoom to one country, and click a row to open the full record, see how each classification axis was assigned and how confident it is, and, if a label looks wrong, propose a correction that becomes a public issue for moderator review. They download the current view, all filtered trials or site-level data as CSV with a provenance header, or export publication figures.

task.text: Keep an up-to-date, auditable landscape of registered clinical trials for one therapy class, summarised by disease, target, phase, sponsor and geography, with the automatic classification open to checking and correction.

data.text: Trial records pulled from a public clinical-trial registry, each automatically classified on several axes (disease hierarchy, antigen target, product type, modality, sponsor type) with a confidence level, plus their study sites with coordinates and community correction flags.
data.item: one registered clinical trial with its classification labels and study sites

stage.text: exploring and summarising a registry landscape after automatic classification, before writing it up

mechanism.text: A sidebar of cascading multiselect filters drives every tab at once: summary panels, a world map with site dots, deep-dive pivots and publication figures all redraw on the filtered set. A searchable trial table opens a detail card on row click, which shows per-axis classification rationale and confidence and hosts a correction form that opens a pre-filled public issue; a gated moderation tab triages those flags and tracks pipeline-versus-moderator agreement.

field.text: clinical-trial registry landscape analysis in oncology cell therapy

workflow.name: monitor a classified registry and audit its labels

steps.here: Trials are fetched live from the registry API and cached for a day; a reproducibility expander saves the current data as a dated snapshot or pins an earlier one.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: Cascading Branch → Category → Entity multiselects plus phase, target, status, product, modality, country, age, sponsor type and confidence filters, with a reset button.

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: Overview and deep-dive panels count trials by category, target, phase, start year, platform and sponsor; the geography tab aggregates by region and maps open sites per country and city.
Search by title, ID, sponsor or intervention, optionally zoom to one country, then click a row to open the trial card with disease, product and sponsor columns and a link to the registry record.
"How was this classified?" re-runs the classifier on the trial and shows, per axis, the label, its source, the matched terms and a composite confidence with per-axis sub-scores.

steps.step: propose a correction and have it moderated
steps.here: Pick the wrong axes, choose or type the correct label with notes, and open a pre-filled public issue; flagged trials get a marker in the table, and a gated moderation tab approves, rejects or defers consensus flags and draws stratified random trials to confirm.

Download the current view, all filtered trials or site-level data as CSV with a #-prefixed provenance header (snapshot date, filters, row count, classifier version), or export figures as high-resolution PNG or SVG.

distinctive: every trial carries a multi-axis automatic classification with a source tag and confidence, and the detail card exposes the matched terms behind each label
corrections leave the app as structured public issues and only reach the override list after reviewer consensus and moderator approval
pipeline-versus-moderator agreement is tracked per axis with Cohen's kappa once enough validations exist
exports embed snapshot date, filter state and classifier version so a figure or table can be reproduced later
a regulatory-approval milestone strip is overlaid on the trial-start trend figure
